selection_reason: Owner approved the complete Multiversal Implementation Backbone series as the active next subproject after completion of the 21-slice APW/CSW/APM implementation sequence.
objective: Implement the canonical Registry, Data Dictionary and Stable Identity foundation that later MIB tranches will consume. Establish shared provider-neutral definition metadata and deterministic resolution for reusable definitions without copying owner-domain live state or selecting a production persistence/search provider.

application_baseline.rule: Re-fetch App main and migration head once before mutation. Inspect existing definition/reference contracts and logical schema first. Do not reserve migration 0022; add a migration only if MIB-01 proves a genuine durable schema delta rather than a library/index/contract need.

primary_deliverables: stable ID namespace and collision rules
validation profile and cross-platform deterministic evidence where applicable
completion_gate: Existing representative domains can register and resolve reusable definitions through one deterministic provider-neutral contract without copying live owner-domain state, creating a second ledger, weakening visibility/authority boundaries, selecting a production provider, or requiring AI. Exact-head repository health and the required self-hosted product validation gate must pass before merge.
nonauthorization: MIB-02 or later implementation before MIB-01 completion
next_action: Re-fetch Multiversal-app main and migration head; inventory existing reusable-definition/reference contracts, schemas and migrations across D07/A2, assets, D24/D25, D18/D28/D29, crafting/economy/vehicle/base and creator/automation seams; produce the smallest canonical registry/data-dictionary implementation plan from live seams, decide migration need, then implement MIB-01 on a bounded App branch.
